_source: Campaign Operations, Chaos Campaign rules (pp. 156-173). Numbers are the book's; where the book gives a range or leaves the choice to the GM, the pick is ours and marked 'pick'.
_starting_wp: pick: the book leaves starting WP to the GM (p. 160); enough for one contract with some spare.
_track_cost_share: p. 173: a track costs 75% of all its Objective and Option rewards.
_enemy_bv_percent: pick: tracks size the opposition as a percentage of the player's deployed force (p. 158); these are the sizes the book's examples use.

objectives.title: Advance Attack
objectives.text: Destroy or cripple at least half of the enemy force.

objectives.title: Hammer
objectives.text: Destroy or cripple at least two-thirds of the enemy force.

objectives.title: Bring the Pain
objectives.text: Destroy or cripple at least 75% of the enemy force.

objectives.title: Annihilate
objectives.text: Destroy or cripple the whole enemy force.

objectives.title: Being Difficult
objectives.text: Keep at least two-thirds of your force operational (not destroyed or crippled).

objectives.title: Stand Your Ground
objectives.text: At least half of your force survives.

objectives.title: Fight Another Day
objectives.text: Lose less than half of your force.

objectives.title: Frugal is the Word
objectives.text: Lose no more than 10% of your force.

objectives.title: Ferocity
objectives.text: Destroy half of the enemy force while losing less than half of yours.

objectives.title: Preserve Your Force
objectives.text: Destroy or cripple half of the enemy force while losing no more than 25% of yours.

options.title: A Cut Above
options.text: Every enemy MechWarrior is one point better at Gunnery and Piloting.

options.title: Bad Intel
options.text: One more enemy 'Mech joins, with a Veteran pilot.

options.title: Bad Weather
options.text: Roll battlefield conditions for this fight.

options.title: Elites
options.text: Half of the enemy pilots are Elite.

options.title: Heavy Fog
options.text: The battle is fought in low visibility.

_options: wp = pick inside the book's range (p. 170-171). Bad Weather and Heavy Fog use the Core Rulebook's Battlefield Conditions Table and Low Visibility in place of Tactical Operations (TODO(rules)).
_skill_levels: [gunnery, piloting] from the Recruitment table, p. 161.
